## Constraints

### ck_even

```{python}
#| label: fig-ck-even
#| fig-cap: "ck_even: 1-LUT even parity check"
dot("""digraph "ck_even" {
label="ck_even";
rankdir="LR";
remincross=true;
n1 [ shape=octagon, label="coord", color="black", fontcolor="black" ];
n2 [ shape=octagon, label="result", color="black", fontcolor="black" ];
c5 [ shape=record, label="{{<p3> A}|$81\n$_NOT_|{<p4> Y}}",  ];
x0 [ shape=record, style=rounded, label="<s0> 0:0 - 0:0 ", color="black", fontcolor="black" ];
x0:e -> c5:p3:w [arrowhead=odiamond, arrowtail=odiamond, dir=both, color="black", fontcolor="black", label=""];
n1:e -> x0:s0:w [color="black", fontcolor="black", label=""];
c5:p4:e -> n2:w [color="black", fontcolor="black", label=""];
}
""", h="200px")
```

### ck_eq

```{python}
#| label: fig-ck-eq
#| fig-cap: "ck_eq: 64-bit equality check (XOR + NOR tree)"
d = (Path("_include/sv_dots").resolve() / "ck_eq.dot").read_text()

```

### ck_gt

```{python}
#| label: fig-ck-gt
#| fig-cap: "ck_gt: 64-bit greater-than comparator"
d = (Path("_include/sv_dots").resolve() / "ck_gt.dot").read_text()
dot(d, h="300px")
```

| Module | Description | Logic |
|---|---|---|
| `ck_even` | 1 LUT parity check | XOR reduction |
| `ck_range_010` | Hard-coded [0,10] comparator | 2 comparators + AND |
| `ck_range` | Parameterized [min, max] | 2 comparators + AND |
| `ck_eq` | Equality check | 64-bit XOR + NOR tree |
| `ck_gt` | Greater-than check | 64-bit comparator |
